feedback:
This revision closes the structural defects from the last round, and I verified each against the current text rather than accepting the summary. Diarization now has a run kind, an entry stage, a cancellation effect in D-007, a recovery transition in D-031 and admission accounting in D-004 and D-027, and it has its own sandboxed service in D-003 with the stated reason that RESEARCH records implicit-download behavior for that runtime. D-029 replaces the single parent column with result_dependencies carrying a typed input kind, which is what lets a note name an assignment revision, and D-037 makes notes a separate run created after its inputs commit so the manifest pins values that exist when it is fsynced. D-030 now fsyncs the encoded bytes before the record that names them, carries per-packet sizes and a CRC, commits through a seal record, and orders surviving chunks ahead of the packet table, with a structural fallback if reconstruction proves invalid. D-038 supplies the archived and orphaned_runtime states that bound weight storage while keeping History attributable. D-036 settles distribution as a decision on the basis the specification itself supplies, so no self-declared blocking question stands. D-025 no longer posts an unattributed media key automatically, which was the REVIEW_NOTES objection. D-011 reserves the speech-primary slot so the preview ladder is executable and no longer degrades to waveform only. D-012 removes the override that let a mode contradict its own answersQuestions declaration and distills every context source by default. D-020 builds the comparison arm inside F1 so its retention criterion can be evaluated. D-033 reclaims leases by holder liveness and names the session directory as pre-commit ownership. Those objections no longer apply.

What remains is smaller than the last round and still blocks acceptance.

Delivery. D-009 permits rung 2 only after a non-success AXError, on the stated ground that the result is returned before any effect on the target. Nothing in RESEARCH or in F4 establishes that for every error the accessibility API returns; a timeout-class result can be returned after the target began applying the write, which puts duplicate insertion back into the one path the design claims is safe. Either classify that result class as unconfirmed or make F4 establish the claim. Second, rung 3 is reachable only through a profile entry, and the evolution section claims an unmaintained profile degrades to unconfirmed rather than to duplicated text. No applicability or expiry rule scopes a profile to the target and OS versions it was measured against, so a stale rejection signal that fires spuriously after an application update reaches rung 3 and types over a paste. Third, D-010 lists rejected as non-terminal, and the launch rule converts only pending, in_progress and unconfirmed to needs_review, so a crash between rungs leaves an attempt row with no defined disposition in a table the design presents as complete. The submission objection is weaker: revalidating process, window and element before Return is reasonable, and confirming the insertion range as well is an improvement rather than a blocker.

Egress boundary. D-003 and D-028 state the sandboxed no-network boundary has no fallback outside it, then D-028's consequences keep the external decoder available with a disclosed trust transfer if sandbox inheritance does not hold. Those two statements conflict, and the second one puts the user's imported audio in an unconstrained process under an opt-in. The review's demand to delete the extension goes further than the specification, which asks for an extension mechanism; the fix is to make inheritance a shipping condition for the command-line adapter, move decoding in-process, or scope the boundary claim explicitly to cover a user-supplied binary rather than asserting it absolutely and then excepting it.

Materialized model assets. D-003 offers materialization inside a service container as one of three access mechanisms, and the consequences say the model manager reports the second copy. Nothing else in the design owns it. The store layout has no path for it, D-038 archives Models/blobs only, garbage collection is defined over blobs with no installed row and no live lease, and the architecture states in the same section that a service writes none of its state to disk, which materialization contradicts and which D-016 also contradicts for DecodeService scratch. That leaves a multi-gigabyte on-disk artifact class with no owner, no deletion rule and no participation in the bound D-038 exists to establish, which is the persistent-data deferral the specification prohibits.

Long-duration resources. The memory-proportionality clause is bounded for recognition through the credit window and measured across three durations in the app and the speech service. Diarization is not: F5 uses two-speaker and four-speaker fixtures with no duration, the assumption about diarizer footprint covers weights only, and no ingest or per-job working-data contract bounds a diarizer over a three-hour meeting, which is the longest recording the product produces. The external decoder is outside the same measurement; credit on its output does not establish that the decoder avoids buffering the file.

Desktop ownership over time. D-025 correctly makes an identified-player adapter the only automatic path, and the manual action for unsupported players satisfies the specification. The residual gap is that automatic resume is conditioned on the player still being paused and nothing else having changed it, while the adapter contract describes only querying state, issuing a pause and observing the transition. Polling and finding the player paused cannot distinguish an untouched pause from a play and re-pause by the user, so the ownership condition the specification names is not observable under the mechanism as described. Require adapters that perform automatic resume to expose state-change events or a generation token, restrict the rest to manual resume, and name the initial adapter set, since coverage of the automatic path is otherwise unspecified.

Layering. D-002 says core depends only on DictationPorts, TransformationContract and ContractChecker live in TextValidation, and D-012 has core decide disposition from checker results. No validation port appears in the ports list and no core dependency on TextValidation is permitted, so the layering rule contradicts the component assignment. Trivially fixable by adding a port or by permitting the dependency on that deterministic target, but as written the two statements cannot both hold.

Verification. The state-machine suite asserts that every non-recognition result has a primary input, while D-029 gives a diarization result no textual parent and audio dependency rows instead, so a correct implementation fails the stated assertion. Invariants need to be per result kind. The DER range records its basis as roughly one segment in three mislabeled; diarization error rate is time weighted and includes missed speech and false alarm, so the recorded basis does not describe what the number measures, which matters in a design that asks the approver to distinguish derived criteria from invented ones. The preview criterion of no change in final word error rate beyond measurement noise has no tolerance or sample size and cannot select a rung as written. Translation is a named behavior under Languages with a separate evaluation obligation in the specification, and no protocol or corpus evaluates it: the fidelity corpus is per mode per language and translation is not a mode.

Minor and deferrable: the local-import identity rule when publisher, revision or notice metadata is absent is unstated, though the design says elsewhere that such assets stay importable and that quality scores never gate activation, so the review's stronger claim that compatible imports could be refused is speculative; notices keyed by setHash conflate byte-identical assets carrying different terms; D-017's detection threshold has no recorded value; D-037 has no representation for an edited segment boundary despite offering split; D-016 releases source strings at prompt assembly with no rule for a run that never assembles one; F3's sample-rate reduction fallback conflicts with retaining native-rate meeting artifacts.

Not stuck. Every confirmed defect is resolvable inside this design without evidence the material cannot supply: classify or measure the accessibility error class, version-scope and expire delivery profiles, give rejected a recovery transition, make decoder isolation a shipping condition or scope the boundary claim, give materialized assets a path, accounting, lease relationship and deletion, extend duration measurement to the diarization service and the decoder or impose a windowed diarization contract, require state-change observability for automatic resume and name the initial adapters, put the contract types on an allowed dependency path, make invariants per result kind, correct the DER basis, define the preview tolerance, and add a bilingual translation evaluation against the retained source transcript.
